title: Mon Mothma
description: The Senator from the planet Chandrila, Mon Mothma was a secret founder of the Rebellion. She strived to assemble the Rebel factions into one cohesive alliance. Mon Mothma knew she was being watched by the Imperial Security Bureau and acted with caution. She was angry at fellow Rebel Luthen Rael over his Aldhani heist because of its potential fallout.
